Round 2 — visual QA review

Skip Rocks for Brainrots · branch ui-foundation @ 40fe7ee · captured 2026-09-18 from a Studio Play session on the owner's profile (52 brainrots, 16/16 on plot). Desktop viewport 1891×793; phone = Device Simulator iPhone 16 landscape (733×371). No source changed for this review.

Checks

Text overlap Pass

0 overlapping glyph rects on all 9 screens (desktop + phone); 0 labels with text larger than their box. Bag desktop 96/115 labels, Bag phone 91, Goals 19, Pass 38, Luck 33, Rock Shop 21, Egg Shop 82 / 17.

Panel / HUD overlap Mixed

Desktop Bag, Progress, Luck: 0 painted HUD elements under the panel. Desktop shops: 2 px clip of the gem '+' (finding 2). Phone Egg Shop: HIDE UI covers the close button (finding 1).

Close buttons Pass

Bag, Progress (Goals + Pass), Luck, Rock Shop and Egg Shop closes clicked through the input tool and read back hidden; Bag close also present in the phone layout. Sell panel not exercised.

Open / close animation Caveat

Pop + glide verified structurally (open 0.94 → 1.006 → 1.00 with a 26 px slide; close 1.00 → 0.97 with an 18 px slide). Smoothness could not be judged: the client ran at ~15 fps under external load (finding 6).

400-item Bag Caveat

Built and scrolled a 400-item snapshot (canvas 5097 px); CullerLive stayed ≤ 32 of the 64 cap. Bench: card new 1.0–1.5 ms, mount 0.6–1.3 ms → ≈100 ms first screen, then ≈30 ms per chunk frame. Wall-clock frame times unusable this session (finding 6).

Gems terminology Pass

0 of 2560 runtime labels contain 'Emerald' or 'Darrel'. World hits are the DARREL bust (the character) and a leaderboard player 'darreltvv'. Source sweep: only identifiers and comments remain.

Findings, most important first

  1. Fix firstPhone Egg Shop: HIDE UI draws over the close buttonHudToggleUI (DisplayOrder 30) sits above EggShopUI (25) and covers 41–53 % of the X on the iPhone 16 layout; the scooter tab, VIP and Sprint chrome crowd the panel's right edge. The merchant panel (24) has the same exposure. Fix options: hide HudToggleUI / ScooterUI / the sprint button while a shop is open (the GameHUD panels already hide the rail on phone), or raise the two shops above order 30.
  2. MinorDesktop shops clip the gem '+' button by 2 pxBoth 961 px shop panels are centred, so their left edge (x = 464) lands on GemPill.Bar.Buy (ends at x = 466). Cosmetic at 1891 px wide, worse on narrower laptops. The shops also cover the top-centre SKIP / SHOPS / PLOT tab bar, which is under them by DisplayOrder (hidden, not colliding).
  3. Should fixLuck flyout has no visible close controlHeadline.Close is an invisible hit area over the green ×14.97 plate; the Luck chip toggles the panel. Works, but nothing tells the player where to tap. Suggest the kit X in the title row.
  4. MinorPass ladder is short on desktop; reward names truncate unevenlyThe ladder window is 259 px inside the 587 px panel, so three tiers show at once out of 50. 'Heartwood Egg…' truncates in the FREE column while the PREMIUM column fits 'Heartwood Egg.'
  5. MinorFoil sparkle peeks around the pad pipOn GOD/SECRET cards Sparkle3 (anchored 0.88, 0.42) sits under the equipped pip. Cosmetic; the pip draws on top.
  6. CaveatFrame-time numbers from this session are not usableA fullscreen game had the GPU and Studio was unfocused: ~15 fps with 150–700 ms stalls even with every panel closed (idle p50 66 ms, max 470 ms). Animation and 400-item checks are structural + micro-benchmarked, not felt. Re-run on a focused client before sign-off — the synthetic snapshot seam and samplers are ready.
